relationships.subject: SUMOylation
relationships.evidence_quote: different studies have identified, as SUMOylation targets, several ion channels involved in pain transmission, such as sodium channels 1.7 (Nav1.7)

relationships.subject: beta2 adrenergic receptor agonist
relationships.evidence_quote: Application of a ß2 agonist to a culture of activated primary microglia induced a reduction in pro-inflammatory cytokines and an increase in the release of anti-inflammatory cytokines

key_findings: Editorial summarizing a Special Issue on molecular and cellular mechanisms of chronic pain chronicity (nerve injury, cancer, Fabry disease models).
Highlights roles of microglial beta2-AR, SUMOylation of Nav1.7/TRPV1, epigenetic mediators and cytokines in chronic pain.
